body:

I missed my test exam and was just on time for the real exam right after that because i did not get a notifycation / reminder i set the evening and a few ours before.

I was allowed in because an agenda bug was a valid excuse.

I love the app but I’m disappointed that the syncing in between phones is not on the same standard like games for example while an agenda is more important than that.

I really assumed that everything would sync without it being an option because i’m not aware of a setting like that.

Both phones were up to date and i’d like to share pictures of the 2 phones different agenda’s on a support email.

I really want to prevent this in the future because i need my agenda synced easily because i have bad memory.

title: Nice, but missing things
body:
The calendar app is a very clean app with ofcourse its great integration in the Apple ecosystem. 
I would still want to add a few more features tho, for me it would be life changing to see a week overview instead of only days or months. It’s possible when using the iPhone in landscape mode but it would be so much nicer to have it in vertical mode as well, just like on the Apple Watch. Only this time you’re able to put some actual text in calendar appointments. Talking about day new features, why not add a date or time picker as well? This way you’re able to organise meetings for example and see what date and time the most people would be able to attend. And why not integrate reminders in Calendars. Or add a little weather indication of the weather that day. These are some of my ideas that would be a great addition to what’s already been a very steady and innovative agenda on iPhone.
